name: PinguOverloadedV1
label: Overloaded
prompt: Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: compact illustrated badge for CircleU journal cards. Reference image is a CHARACTER AND STYLE REFERENCE ONLY, not an edit target. Create one new standalone transparent PNG, square canvas, no words, no lettering, no border or background disk. Preserve this exact penguin identity: deep navy rounded head and body, white face, single crest, orange small beak, pale blue scarf. Modern matte softly dimensional illustration, clean edges, restrained shading, no sketch texture. Compact head-and-upper-body composition filling 80% of canvas with clear safe padding, not full body, large simple silhouette readable at 40–48 points. One simple distinctive prop only, no scattered tiny accessories. Palette navy #0D1421, blue #054FC9, ice #F5FAFF, sky #47C7FF, small orange beak. No glossy plastic, no medical symbols, no celebratory rewards. Feeling badge: penguin with mildly tired brows and one flipper resting against its temple; one simple blue tangled loop thought cloud directly above its head. No tears, panic, anger, dizziness stars, burden pile or smiling celebration. Keep its face gentle and recognisable; blue scarf visible.
